subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should OpenClaw make live provider model discovery part of the default model catalog and picker behavior, or keep dynamic discovery limited to explicit provider wildcards and provider-specific runtime flows?
rationale: The remaining decision changes provider API contracts, config semantics, model selection UX, cache/offline policy, and safety/cost controls, which source inspection cannot decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical product decision while reviewing narrower provider-specific PRs against the chosen API and UX contract.

options.title: Split By Provider
options.body: Break the remaining work into OpenRouter, OpenAI-compatible, Ollama/local, and gateway-specific issues with one shared plugin API decision.

options.title: Limit To Wildcards
options.body: Declare `provider/*` configuration the supported dynamic-discovery surface and close broader default list/picker discovery as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical product decision while reviewing narrower provider-specific PRs against the chosen API and UX contract.
